name: Main engine exhaust gas temperature (per cylinder)
typical_use: Detects cylinder-to-cylinder imbalance, fuel injection faults, turbocharger fouling

name: Main engine jacket cooling water temperature
typical_use: Detects cooling system degradation and overheating trends

name: Main engine lube oil pressure
typical_use: Detects bearing wear, pump degradation, filter clogging

name: Main engine crankcase oil mist concentration
typical_use: Early warning for bearing overheating and crankcase explosion risk

name: Main engine main bearing vibration
typical_use: Detects bearing spalling, misalignment, and developing mechanical faults

name: Main engine fuel injection pressure
typical_use: Detects injector wear and fuel pump degradation

name: Main engine turbocharger speed
typical_use: Detects turbocharger bearing wear and fouling

name: Main engine scavenge air pressure
typical_use: Detects air filter fouling and turbocharger efficiency loss

name: Main engine cylinder liner wear (ultrasonic gauge)
typical_use: Tracks long-term liner wear for overhaul planning

name: Main engine crankshaft deflection
typical_use: Detects bearing wear and misalignment during periodic survey

name: Generator engine exhaust gas temperature
typical_use: Detects generator engine combustion faults, not main engine

name: Accommodation HVAC cabin temperature
typical_use: Crew comfort monitoring, unrelated to propulsion machinery

name: Ballast tank level
typical_use: Stability and trim management

name: Bridge radar return signal
typical_use: Collision avoidance and navigation, unrelated to engine maintenance

name: GPS position
typical_use: Vessel tracking and voyage management

name: Engine room fire alarm status
typical_use: Fire detection, a safety system rather than a CBM diagnostic signal

name: Potable water tank level
typical_use: Domestic water supply management

name: Mooring winch line load
typical_use: Mooring operation safety, unrelated to main engine

name: Bow thruster motor current
typical_use: Detects bow thruster motor degradation, not main engine

name: Main engine propeller shaft torsional vibration
typical_use: Detects torsional resonance and shaft fatigue risk
